✨ Qwen-Edit Relight: Advanced Image Relighting with LoRA Technology

Welcome to the world of AI-powered image relighting! The Qwen-Edit-2509 Image Fusion LoRA model brings incredible performance to transform your images with sophisticated lighting techniques. 🎨

🚀 What is Qwen-Edit Relight?

The Qwen-Edit Relight model is a powerful LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) extension that leverages the Qwen-Edit-2509 framework for advanced image fusion and relighting capabilities. This cutting-edge technology allows users to dramatically alter the lighting conditions of any image while maintaining photorealistic quality.

🛠️ Two Methods to Use the Mode

Method 1: Direct Prompt-Based Editing

Use the prompt words included in the dataset to directly modify image lighting conditions without additional setup.

Method 2: LoRA Integration with Trigger Words

After installing the LoRA model, utilize the Chinese trigger word: 重新照明 (Relighting)

Example Usage:

1

重新照明,使用窗帘透光（柔和漫射）的光线对图片进行重新照明

Translation: “Relighting, using the soft, diffuse light from the curtains to relight the image”

📥 Installation Instructions

Step 1: Download the LoRA File

Download Qwen-Edit-Relight.safetensors and place it in your models/loras folder.

Step 2: Required Dependencies

You must also download and install the companion LoRA from: Qwen-Image-Lightning

🎬 LongCat-Video: Revolutionary AI Video Generation Model

Introducing LongCat-Video - A powerful 13.6B parameter foundational video generation model

[](https://github.com/meituan-lo ngcat/LongCat-Video) [](h ttps://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video)

[] (https://github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video) [](https:// github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video)

[](https://github.c om/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video/blob/main/LICENSE)

🚀 Model Introduction

LongCat-Video represents a breakthrough in AI video generation technology. This foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters delivers exceptional performance across Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation generation tasks. The model particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, marking a significant step toward world models.

⭐ Key Features

  • 🌟 Unified architecture for multiple tasks: LongCat-Video unifies Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation tasks within a single video generation framework. It natively supports all these tasks with a single model and consistently delivers strong performance across each individual task.

  • 🌟 Long video generation: LongCat-Video is natively pretrained on Video-Continuation tasks, enabling it to produce minutes-long videos without color drifting or quality degradation.

  • 🌟 Efficient inference: LongCat-Video generates 720p, 30fps videos within minutes by employing a coarse-to-fine generation strategy along both the temporal and spatial axes. Block Sparse Attention further enhances efficiency, particularly at high resolutions.

  • 🌟 Strong performance with multi-reward RLHF: Powered by multi-reward Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), comprehensive evaluations on both internal and public benchmarks demonstrate that LongCat-Video achieves performance comparable to leading open-source video generation models as well as the latest commercial solutions.

For comprehensive details, please refer to the LongCat-Video Technical Report.

item.title: Ditto: Scaling Instruction-Based Video Editing with a High-Quality Synthetic Dataset
item.description:
🎬 Ditto: Scaling Instruction-Based Video Editing with a High-Quality Synthetic Dataset

Instruction-based video editing results produced by the Ditto framework, enabling high-quality video editing through natural language instructions.

This repository introduces the groundbreaking Ditto framework and the Editto model, addressing one of the most significant challenges in instruction-based video editing: the scarcity of high-quality training data. The framework represents a comprehensive solution that combines innovative data generation, efficient model architecture, and intelligent quality control.

📋 Abstract

Instruction-based video editing promises to democratize content creation, yet its progress has been severely hampered by the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality training data. Ditto introduces a holistic framework designed to tackle this fundamental challenge through several key innovations:

  • 🎨 Novel Data Generation Pipeline: Fuses the creative diversity of a leading image editor with an in-context video generator, overcoming the limited scope of existing models
  • ⚡ Efficient Architecture: Employs a distilled model architecture augmented by a temporal enhancer, reducing computational overhead while improving temporal coherence
  • 🤖 Intelligent Agent: Crafts diverse instructions and rigorously filters output, ensuring quality control at scale

Using this framework, the team invested over 12,000 GPU-days to build Ditto-1M, a new dataset of one million high-fidelity video editing examples. The resulting Editto model demonstrates superior instruction-following ability and establishes a new state-of-the-art in instruction-based video editing.

item.title: FlashVSR: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Super-Resolution
item.description:
⚡ FlashVSR: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Super-Resolution

FlashVSR demonstrates real-time video super-resolution capabilities with state-of-the-art performance

Authors: Junhao Zhuang, Shi Guo, Xin Cai, Xiaohui Li, Yihao Liu, Chun Yuan, Tianfan Xue

🌟 Abstract

Diffusion models have recently advanced video restoration, but applying them to real-world video super-resolution (VSR) remains challenging due to high latency, prohibitive computation, and poor generalization to ultra-high resolutions. Our goal in this work is to make diffusion-based VSR practical by achieving efficiency, scalability, and real-time performance.

To this end, we propose FlashVSR, the first diffusion-based one-step streaming framework towards real-time VSR. FlashVSR runs at ∼17 FPS for 768 × 1408 videos on a single A100 GPU by combining three complementary innovations:

  1. A train-friendly three-stage distillation pipeline that enables streaming super-resolution
  2. Locality-constrained sparse attention that cuts redundant computation while bridging the train–test resolution gap
  3. A tiny conditional decoder that accelerates reconstruction without sacrificing quality

To support large-scale training, we also construct VSR-120K, a new dataset with 120k videos and 180k images. Extensive experiments show that FlashVSR scales reliably to ultra-high resolutions and achieves state-of-the-art performance with up to ∼12× speedup over prior one-step diffusion VSR models.

FlashVSR represents a significant breakthrough in real-time video super-resolution technology by successfully bridging the gap between high-quality diffusion models and practical deployment requirements. The framework’s innovative three-stage distillation pipeline, combined with locality-constrained sparse attention and a tiny conditional decoder, achieves an impressive balance between speed and quality.

Key takeaways include:

  • Real-time Performance: Achieving ∼17 FPS for high-resolution videos on single GPU hardware
  • Scalability: Successfully handling ultra-high resolutions that were previously impractical
  • Efficiency Gains: Up to 12× speedup over existing one-step diffusion VSR models
  • Practical Implementation: Complete inference code and pre-trained models available for immediate use

The upcoming release of the VSR-120K dataset will further accelerate research in this domain, providing the community with valuable resources for large-scale video super-resolution training. FlashVSR sets a new standard for practical diffusion-based video enhancement applications.
